# Continuous Integration for Shell Scripts

GitHub Actions workflow for automated ShellCheck and Bats test execution:

```yaml
name: Lint & Test Scripts
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run ShellCheck
        uses: ludeeus/action-shellcheck@master
      - name: Run Bats Tests
        run: sudo apt-get install -y bats && bats test/
```
